name: csvProcess
description: Reads a CSV file line by line, filtering and transforming each row with the functions you pass in.

params.name: filePath
params.description: Path of the CSV file to read.

params.name: rowProcessor
params.description: Function called for each row. It receives the row and row number.

params.name: csvFormatConfiguration
params.description: Struct of parsing options: delimiter, encoding, escapeCharacter, ignoreEmptyLines, nullString, quoteCharacter and trailingDelimiter.

params.name: rowFilter
params.description: Function that returns true for rows to process.

params.name: processRowAsJavaArray
params.description: true to pass each row as a Java array, for better performance.
